details.description: This target is Fireworks AI's '-long' build of Meta's Llama 3.1 405B Instruct, the same multilingual, instruction-tuned 405-billion-parameter model Meta released July 23, 2024, offered as a separate on-demand deployment on Fireworks' infrastructure. Meta's model card gives the Llama 3.1 405B Instruct family a December 2023 knowledge cutoff and names English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish and Thai as supported languages. Fireworks' page for this specific '-long' variant does not explain the naming or state a separate context-length figure, and lists it as available only through on-demand, dedicated-GPU deployment.
advantages: As the same underlying model, it scores 87.3 on MMLU, 89.0% on HumanEval and 96.8% on GSM-8K (CoT), per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
Scores 92.0% on the API-Bank tool-use benchmark and 88.6 on IFEval, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.
disadvantages: Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's Llama 3.1 model card.

This deployment's context window is only 4,096 tokens per the catalog's facts, far short of the 128,000 tokens Meta documents for the general Llama 3.1 405B Instruct family; neither Meta nor Fireworks' page for this '-long' build explains the smaller figure or the variant's naming.
use_cases: Multilingual conversational agents across the eight supported languages
Coding assistants and agentic systems using function calling and external tools
Synthetic data generation and distillation into smaller models

notes: Fireworks' page for this '-long' variant lists context length as 'N/A' and gives no explanation of the suffix or how it differs from llama-v3p1-405b-instruct; description and evaluations use Meta's published figures for the underlying 405B Instruct model, which Fireworks confirms this is. The catalog's own facts show a 4,096-token max input/output for this target, smaller than the 128,000 shown for the plain llama-v3p1-405b-instruct target despite the '-long' name (now stated in disadvantages) -- worth checking against Bud's own deployment config, since no source explains the discrepancy.
